goal: Make Forleads the market-test-ready evidence-to-action layer for geographic real-estate farming across the United States, with Oklahoma as a named launch market and capability claims proven at the exact point of use.
stopRules: Stop before secrets, spending, production mutation, deployment, destructive actions, or external communication unless explicitly approved.
Do not advance from a phase when required gates are red or inconclusive unless the phase is a gate-diagnosis phase.
Never present mock connector success, guessed property facts, or placeholder imagery as real production proof.
Record a checkpoint and phase score after each meaningful phase.

phases.title: Gate Stability
phases.objective: Make the current branch honestly gateable so real-data work can be committed and pushed without skipped proof.
acceptance: Typecheck exits 0.
Focused tests for touched provider/readiness files pass.
Full lint either exits 0 or has a captured root-cause blocker.
Checkpoint records proof and the next exact action.

phases.title: Data Provenance And Source Readiness
phases.objective: Ensure property facts, sales, risk, imagery, and licensed-source readiness are sourced, fresh, and fail closed.
acceptance: At least 20 legitimate source lanes are visible.
Unconfigured paid/licensed sources show setup-required or grade-D gaps.
Assessor/open property feed facts include source and freshness.
Imagery cards render only real provider media with attribution.

phases.title: Approval-Gated Action Loop
phases.objective: Prove note to classification to artifact to approval to connector result to outcome memory without external side effects by default.
acceptance: A deterministic test proves the core action loop.
Stale revisions and compliance-blocked artifacts cannot be approved.
Missing connector credentials produce setup-required, not fake success.

phases.title: Connector Live Posture
phases.objective: Keep Gmail, CRM, SMS, calendar, and webhook writes honest: real only when configured and human-approved.
acceptance: Production factories do not allow mock connector writes.
Missing credentials return setup-required responses.
Idempotency prevents duplicate external writes.

phases.title: Operator UX And Evidence Review
phases.objective: Make the map, evidence, inbox, pipeline, loop studio, connector hub, and trace surfaces usable for real agents.
acceptance: Setup-required states are visible and plain-English.
Evidence media, source, confidence, and reasoning fit on desktop and mobile.
No primary workflow has dead or misleading states.

phases.title: Production Verification And Score
phases.objective: Separate local proof, CI proof, production health, and human-blocked proof in a final readiness record.
acceptance: Production health is probed read-only.
A scorecard records gates, blockers, and next action.
Merge/deploy only happen after green gates and required approval.

phases.title: Capability Truth And Launch Floor
phases.objective: Make configured, credential-verified, capability-verified, point-covered, and degraded states visibly distinct, and stop asking operators to buy keys for unwired adapters.
acceptance: No stub or unused env variable produces a live badge.
Licensed-source cards explain that an adapter must be implemented before a key is useful.
Production-build rendered QA has no client error overlay.
The operator guide separates setup-now from blocked-until-implemented.

phases.title: Oklahoma Official Source Pack
phases.objective: Return official Oklahoma County parcel assessment and sale facts with source, freshness, grade, and no consent inference.
acceptance: A real Oklahoma County address returns live-verified official facts.
The UI describes Oklahoma as county-partial, never statewide-live.
ArcGIS failure, empty, null, schema-drift, and boundary scenarios fail closed.
Public owner fields never populate a consented contact.

phases.title: Contactability And CRM Overlay
phases.objective: Make each property relationship contact-forward and implement provider-person-bound CRM import and writeback.
acceptance: Map and Deals show contact source, allowed channel, and opt-out state beside the property.
FUB/GHL writes bind the correct provider contact id.
Contact imports persist instead of returning only a count.
Cross-tenant, duplicate, missing-address, 401, 429, and timeout paths are covered.

phases.title: Farm Table And Truth-Gap Waterfall
phases.objective: Turn one-address research into an importable, sortable, provenance-first farm workflow with transparent provider cost and misses.
acceptance: A 50-row farm CSV imports with duplicate and malformed-row handling.
Every evidence cell opens source, date, grade, and attempted-provider state.
Bulk runs enforce and display a cost budget.
Export preserves provenance.

phases.title: Evidence-Bound Approvals And Porch Mode
phases.objective: Make field capture and review fast on a phone while preserving evidence and human approval.
acceptance: Approve, edit, and skip cadence always shows trigger, evidence, permission, destination, and side effect.
Porch capture supports fast outcome, note, photo, contact change, and next visit.
Desktop and 390px happy, empty, failure, and recovery paths are rendered and recorded.

phases.title: Verified Nationwide Depth
phases.objective: Preserve the truthful free national baseline and implement one licensed nationwide parcel adapter with visible cost, freshness, quota, and fallback.
acceptance: Representative addresses across every Census region and Oklahoma report point-level coverage truth.
A licensed adapter returns mapped, sourced facts rather than configured-key gaps.
Provider cost, freshness, quota, and degradation are visible.
Paid failure falls back to sourced free layers without invented facts.

phases.title: External Write Reliability And Compliance
phases.objective: Make every external write tenant-bound, consent-aware, idempotent across processes, refresh-safe, and reconcilable after uncertain failure.
acceptance: Two concurrent approvals produce at most one external side effect.
Uncertain outcomes reconcile rather than blindly resend.
Microsoft refresh rotation persists atomically.
Zapier is tenant-bound and SMS remains disabled until consent, DNC/STOP, quiet-hours, sender-scope, and A2P gates pass.

phases.title: Paid Design Partner Market Test
phases.objective: Measure activation, retained use, paid willingness, sourced outcomes, setup blocks, provider misses, and data cost in a four-week cohort.
acceptance: Ten design partners include at least three Oklahoma agents or teams.
Activation, source coverage, actions, replies, appointments, listing opportunities, retention, and cost are measured.
At least three users pay $49-79 without concierge dependence before any PMF claim.
